name: Two returns: a mixing intro, a harmonic opening, a full passage, an exposed break and a changed return

provenance.knowledge: authored: the research manual's arrangement grammars (§4), its lengths and weights as listening hypotheses; no record's arrangement copied
provenance.note: mixing intro (16 or 32, 2:1: the kick and the hats, the mix intro row with its kit gated) → harmonic opening (8 or 16, 1:2: the pads and the line arrive) → the full passage (a drop of 16 and its groove, 32 or 64 in all, 1:3) → the exposed break (16 or 32, 3:1: the harmony alone) → the return (32 or 64, 1:3) with one new principal feature drawn for it (an auxiliary part 4, the bass's answer 3, brighter drums 2, a half-time opening 1), the kit and the bass the same → a mixing outro (16 or 32, 1:2). The grooves take up a longer theme by sixteens.
provenance.plays: drawn by the fast places among the form rows whose window holds the theme's length (deep-house-places.ts FORM rows, the weights by place), off the theme's own stream; its lengths, states and feature each drawn once off a stream of their own (src/phrase-development.ts resolveForm); at nought nowhere else
